📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence #298 (first post in >24h).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)
Monitor 115456700 `[P5] [Triggered] RTC Screen Load has a high p95 latency (x2: 23:08:20Z, 23:24:20Z)`: Triggered 23:08:20Z -> Recovered 23:21:20Z; Triggered 23:24:20Z -> Recovered 23:27:20Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric: `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}` 22:50-23:40Z → 150 pts, 28 > 3s; peak *10.887s @23:07Z*; cluster 23:06-23:10Z (5.0/8.8/10.9/5.5/5.6/4.2s); min 0.475s
  • DD metric (sibling resource): `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/_actionid_*}` 23:00-23:30Z → 29 of 180 pts > 3s; peak 9.617s @23:05Z (co-spike, same minutes)
  • DD metric: `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api} by {host}` 23:00-23:15Z → service-wide p95 max 4.79s @23:05Z (host tag N/A: no single-host attribution)
  • DD logs: `service:runtime-core-api status:error env:prod` 23:00-23:35Z → *0*
  • Reasoning: Latency-only spike: Screen Load and Action Execution p95 rose together at 23:05-23:10Z (peaks 10.9s / 9.6s). 0 error logs. This matches the KB (latency-only, no errors). The two resources spiked in the same 5-minute window, which points to a shared slow dependency rather than a per-resource problem.

Suggested next action: none for ops (within KB bounds).
_Source alerts: n/a (degraded cycle: Slack MCP absent; reconstructed from the DD events API; no permalinks)._

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/115456700
  • DD APM traces >3s: https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service%3Aruntime-core-api%20%40duration%3A%3E3s&start=1795647600000&end=1795649400000
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Aruntime-core-api&exp_agg=avg&start=1795647000&end=1795650000

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
Occurrence #206 (first post in >24h).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Monitor 302057011 `[P3] [Triggered] [CRM] runtime-core-subscriber throughput dropped (possible stall)`: Triggered 01:16:31Z -> Recovered 01:17:31Z; re-Triggered 01:18:31Z -> 01:19:31Z; 01:24:31Z -> 01:32:31Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric: `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()` 00:45-04:00Z → 195 pts; 100 below 2/s (e.g. 1.97 @00:53, 0.87 @01:05, 0.55 @01:06); min 0.283/s @03:03Z; burst to 97.7/s @03:59Z; monitor avg(last_15m) < 2
  • DD logs: `service:runtime-core-subscriber status:error` 00:45-04:00Z → *0*
  • Reasoning: Overnight (19:45-23:00 ET) low-traffic dips under the 2 msg/s floor. 0 consumer errors, and each fire recovered on its own in 1-12 min. This is the KB quiet-period flap.

Suggested next action: none for ops (within KB bounds).

Occurrence #210 (every-10th resurface (#210)).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Monitor 302055141 `[P3] [No data] [CRM] method-mobile-notifications-subscriber heartbeat - consumer silent`: No Data 09:26:21Z -> Recovered 10:14:21Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric: `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()` 04:30-10:30Z → only *21 points in 6h* (sparse); every present point is above the 0.005/s floor (min 0.008 @06:54Z, max 0.108 @07:54Z); the fires are No Data gaps between sparse messages
  • DD logs: `service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber status:error` 04:30-10:30Z → *0*
  • Reasoning: Heartbeat "No Data" overnight (00:53-05:26 ET): the consumer is idle between sparse messages, so the 60m window had no data. It is not a stall: every present point is above the floor and there are 0 errors. This is the KB quiet-period shape (heartbeat sibling). Posted as occurrence #210 (every-10th resurface).

Suggested next action: none for ops (within KB bounds).
